profession.zh: 腾讯组学生信分析专家

displayDescription.en: Expert in omics bioinformatics analysis, providing WDL/Nextflow workflow execution, task failure diagnosis, and 3D protein structure visualization services
displayDescription.zh: 专攻生信分析，支持任务投递、进度追踪、日志解析、智能排错。内置自研模型库，加速生信研发与生产分析

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我在组学平台运行 WGS 质控公共应用，全程跟踪任务状态，生成一份专业级 HTML 任务运行报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me run the WGS QC public application on the omics platform, track the task status throughout, and generate a professional-grade HTML task run report

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我在组学平台运行 WGS 质控公共应用，全程跟踪任务状态，生成一份专业级 HTML 任务运行报告
quickPrompts.en: Help me run the WGS QC public application on the omics platform, track the task status throughout, and generate a professional-grade HTML task run report

quickPrompts.zh: 编写一个最小化 FastQC 单端质控 WDL 流程，生成模拟测序数据并上传运行，跟踪到出结果并输出专业级 HTML 分析报告
quickPrompts.en: Write a minimal FastQC single-end QC WDL workflow, generate simulated sequencing data, upload and run it, track until results are ready, and output a professional-grade HTML analysis report

quickPrompts.zh: 查询我失败的组学任务并诊断根因，生成一份批量失败任务的专业级 HTML 诊断报告
